fusions.name: Festering Scrape
fusions.desc: A scrape against an enemy up to 2.5 tiles away that deals 4 damage, rising to 1.2 times that at full reach, and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds, with a 25% chance to leave it [Diseased] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Spur in the Gap
fusions.desc: Drives a spur of reef into a gap the rats have gnawed, dealing 30 damage and leaving the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Warren Outcrop
fusions.desc: Raises a coral outcrop riddled with rat holes that stands for 15 seconds. Rats dart out of it to bite an enemy within 4 tiles for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Wharf Runner

riders.text: you run over it faster than over ground
and blows miss you more often while you are on it
and your stamina comes back faster while you are on it

fusions.desc: You walk on water and swamp as on solid ground.
